children: China travel platform's Q2 revenue grew 6% yr/yr to RMB15.7 bln
Adjusted EPS for Q2 rose slightly to RMB7.27
Company posted net loss of RMB2.4 bln due to RMB5.2 bln anti-monopoly penalty
Company did not provide specific guidance for the current quarter or full year
INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Co said international platform revenue rose over 50% yr/yr, with inbound travel revenue up at a high double-digit rate
MACRO HEADWINDS - Co attributed quarter-over-quarter revenue decline and lower transportation ticketing revenue to elevated energy prices and geopolitical volatility
REGULATORY IMPACT - Accommodation revenue growth partly offset by contra-revenue imposed by Chinese regulator
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 21 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the leisure & recreation peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Trip.com Group Limited is HK$508.00, about 63.2% above its September 15 closing price of HK$311.20
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
